cards.title: Connect your Claude account
cards.description: Claude now has its own connection and private sign-in controls. Your selected provider, saved chat and unsent drafts stay separate from other accounts.

cards.title: Shared agent tools
cards.description: Claude uses the same authorized contextual UI components in chat. Live model verification and additional ACP connections are still in progress.

cards.title: Ready after agent startup
cards.description: The connection stays in Connecting until the agent finishes startup. A startup failure keeps the connection unavailable, and you can stop while it connects.

cards.title: Live agent work continues
cards.description: Your saved account and chats stay in place. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections remain in progress.

cards.title: Clearer connection status
cards.description: The Codex connection now asks you to sign in only when the provider confirms you are signed out. A failed status check shows that the connection needs attention.

cards.title: Live agent work continues
cards.description: Your saved provider choice, account and chats stay in place. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections remain in progress.

cards.title: Agent startup correction installed
cards.description: The Codex connection now uses the supported startup correction. Fresh sessions stay within the existing private-profile limits.

cards.title: Live agent verification continues
cards.description: Your provider choice and saved chats are retained. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections are still in progress.

cards.title: Choose your agent provider
cards.description: The chat now saves your provider choice and keeps each account’s conversation separate. Unsent drafts return when switching between providers in the open app.

cards.title: Connection support stays explicit
cards.description: Providers without a supported connection remain unavailable instead of falling back to Codex. Additional ACP connections and the Codex startup correction are still in progress.

cards.title: Reconnect a stopped conversation
cards.description: Reconnect now checks your saved conversation and restarts a stopped connection, keeping the transcript and your unsent draft.

cards.title: Provider startup correction in progress
cards.description: The connection can still stop shortly after subscription sign-in. The provider startup correction and real agent verification are still in progress.

cards.title: A conversation, with room to work
cards.description: The new shell gives chat the workspace and supports contextual components alongside it. Closing a panel returns that space to chat. The live agent integration is still being verified.

cards.title: Connect your ChatGPT subscription
cards.description: Start sign-in from the conversation using your own ChatGPT subscription. The connection and saved chat belong to your Maipa account. The live agent workflow is awaiting its final sign-in and model verification.

cards.title: Private agent UI tools
cards.description: Agent UI requests now keep your account and access boundaries. Provider sign-in and live chat are still in progress.

cards.title: Manage your clients and entities
cards.description: Administrators and preparers can create their own client records, add entities and change display names in Client setup beside the conversation. Changes keep a history, and conflicting edits require a reload before another save.

cards.title: Agent connection is still being built
cards.description: Private agent profile storage now has account ownership and isolated-worker checks. Provider sign-in and live conversations remain in progress.

cards.title: Manage local users and roles
cards.description: Administrators can add local users and update workspace roles and access in Users and access beside the conversation. Changes keep a revision history, conflicting edits require a reload, and the last active administrator stays protected.

cards.title: Agent setup is still in progress
cards.description: Private agent accounts keep their own scope. Provider connection and live conversations are still being built.

cards.title: Private storage for future agent work
cards.description: Maipa now preserves owned agent-resource records and checks their saved files through backup and restore. Provider account connection and live conversations are still being built.

cards.title: Your appearance and work view follow your account
cards.description: Choose System, Light or Dark and switch between Client facts and Workspace guide. Your choices now restore after sign-in and in another browser.

cards.title: Reload a changed preference
cards.description: If another tab changes your choices or a save cannot be confirmed, Maipa offers an explicit reload of your saved preferences before another change.

cards.title: Start in your browser
cards.description: Create your local administrator with a username and password, then continue with the saved account-setup conversation. There is no setup code or file to find.

cards.title: Keep your workspace through app updates
cards.description: Local installation storage now stays separate from application code. Administrator maintenance tools can back up and restore saved accounts, setup conversations and pane widths. Existing installations have an explicit migration path that preserves their sign-in state.

cards.title: More setup is still ahead
cards.description: Live provider connections, conversations and automated workflows remain in progress. Saved appearance and view preferences are the next storage work.

cards.title: Your pane width follows your account
cards.description: Drag the divider or use its keyboard controls to save your pane width. It restores after sign-in and in another browser. Conflicting or unconfirmed saves offer an explicit reload.

cards.title: Change work views alongside your conversation
cards.description: Client facts and the workspace guide share the work area while your account setup conversation and unsent reply remain open. Live agent account connection is still being built.

cards.title: Review your client authority
cards.description: Client facts now include recorded financial and workflow authority, with duties, limits, validity and source references. You can revoke your recorded authority and reload its current state. The server checks exact approvals, scope, revisions, expiry and revocation. Financial execution and automated workflow runs are still being built.

cards.title: Set up your local Maipa
cards.description: New installations can create their administrator in the browser. Your account then has a saved guided conversation for your name, client, currency and reporting basis, with review before saving real client facts. Setup resumes after sign-in. Live agent connection remains a separate setup step.

cards.title: Reload your client facts
cards.description: Reload facts now retries a failed engagement list as well as the current record. The list refreshes without switching away from your selected entity.

cards.title: Client facts with a history
cards.description: Create private engagements and entities, record known or unknown facts with source references and effective dates, and review earlier assertions. Legal form and tax classification stay separate. Conflicting edits require a reload and review before another save.

cards.title: Private connection workers
cards.description: Connection checks now run in a separate Windows security boundary. Checks verify their worker has stopped, and private accounts and connection history continue to follow your workspace role and ownership. Live provider setup and conversations are still being built.

cards.title: Sign in to your workspace
cards.description: Provisioned workspace members can now sign in and out. Access follows your server-assigned role, while private agent accounts and connection history stay with their owner. Live agent conversations and automated workflows are still being built.
